results.title: Jackson formally clinches Democratic nod to take on Collins in Maine Senate race
results.description: Former Maine Senate President Troy Jackson formally clinched the Democratic nod to take on Sen. results.title: Visiting UN chief urges respect for Syria's sovereignty and international support
results.description: Guterres is the first UN chief to visit Syria since his predecessor Ban Ki-moon in 2009, two years before the start of Syria's war, which went on to kill more than half a million people.

results.title: Colin Kaepernick Honored with ACLU Ralph Ellison Award for Civil Rights and Civil Liberties
results.description: Colin Kaepernick, the former NFL quarterback who knelt during the national anthem in protest against police violence and racial inequality, was honored with the ACLU Ralph Ellison Award for Defenders of Civil Rights and Civil Liberties in the Arts, Business, Science and Sports. He was joined by rock star Bruce Springsteen in receiving the award.
